en.title: Longest Contiguous Substring of Single Character
en.description:
You are given a string containing only lowercase English letters. Find the longest substring of contiguous identical characters; if several are tied in length, choose the rightmost one. Output the string formed by concatenating that character with the length of the substring.

The input format and the supplementary limits listed for this problem were compiled by CSWork; they do not imply that the original source uses this protocol.
en.input: One line containing the string source, 1≤|source|≤100, consisting only of a-z (source constraint).
en.output: Output one character followed by the length of the longest contiguous run; on a tie, take the rightmost run.
en.explanation: Process the input according to the rules in the statement; see the accompanying notes for the approach, proof, and complexity.
hints: Scan from left to right, splitting the string into runs of identical characters, and compare run lengths; on equal length, switch to the run that starts further right.
